correctness.rationale: On the frozen source branch f(j)=(j+q) mod n, exactly one unit interval has negative slope -(n-1), and every other interval is a translation. The omitted index n-1 shortens one gcd residue orbit into an (ell-1)-vertex renewal block, while the other gcd(n,q)-1 orbits give length-ell permutation cycles. Block factorization gives (x^(ell-1)-sum_{j=0}^{ell-2}x^j)(x^ell-1)^(g-1), hence graph zeta and entropy log lambda_(ell-1), including ell=2. On each surviving cycle f^ell=id pointwise, so the physical fixed-point count at ell is infinite. Independent exact integer matrix calculations for 21 noncoprime (n,q) pairs n<=12 corroborate but cannot establish all n; the graph orbit decomposition supplies the unrestricted proof.
residual_risks: The symbolic graph zeta cannot be interpreted as a physical-point zeta for g>1; the proof expressly distinguishes them.
